0.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_2
0.description: Of all those sworn to protect the sultanate─the soldiers, the mounted guards, and the knights─the Sultansworn are the elite of the elite. Our conviction unwavering, our hearts true, our sword skills without peer.

1.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_3
1.description: We are bound to defend Sultana Nanamo Ul Namo, even to the death. Such is the solemn oath that we have taken.

2.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_1
2.description: It is a pleasure to see you, paladin. I trust you have been honing your skills.

8.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_5
8.description: A true paladin is one who bends his knee to a higher cause, and offers his sword and shield without promise of reward.

9.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_6
9.description: The battle arts that the paladin learns have been held secret, nurtured, and perfected within the ranks of the Sultansworn elite for nigh on these six hundred years.

10.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_7
10.description: But remember that fancy swordplay and well-polished armor do not make you a paladin. You must be just in your heart and strive always to be an exemplar of true virtue.

11.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_10
11.description: Everyone knows that Ul'dah is ruled by the sultana─but everyone also knows that true power lies with the Syndicate. And at the core of the group is a faction that calls itself the Monetarists.

12.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_11
12.description: Of the six who hold seats on the Syndicate, only General Raubahn is faithful to the sultana. Most of the others refuse to accord her due rights, and work to establish “self-governance” for themselves and their wealthy cohorts. It is they who are the Monetarists. It is they who run the Ul'dahn economy.

13.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_12
13.description: “Self-governance” may sound a noble endeavor, but on their lips the words ring hollow. The faction seeks power, and that is why they plot against the Sultansworn, the sultana's last line of protection. They sowed the seeds of our ruin, and nurture them still. The disgrace of our former captain was their doing, of that I have little doubt.

14.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_030
14.description: Yours is ever a welcome face, paladin. To what do I owe the pleasure?

15.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_011
15.description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Thank you again for visiting our recruits the other day. They were all quite effusive in their praise.

16.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_012
16.description: To hear them speak of it, you would think they had watched a performance by the Songstress of Ul'dah! Anyway, what brings you here today?

17.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_021
17.description: Forgive me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I still want for answers regarding the curious behavior of our souls...

18.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_022
18.description: You are still looking after the boy, are you not? I suspect there is yet a part for him to play in this.

19.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_031
19.description: It fills my heart with joy to see the sultana in good health once more! Doubtless the people of Ul'dah feel the same.

20.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_041
20.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I cannot tell you how wonderful it is to see the sultana up and about. For a time, I was not certain that she would ever─

21.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_042
21.description: Ah, forgive me. You are here to discuss the strange phenomenon we witnessed before, I am sure. Alas, I have yet to learn anything which might shed light on our mystery. For now, I think it best you attend to the boy.

22.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_051
22.description: I should thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. The way you made Oathkeeper shine was truly breathtaking.

23.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_052
23.description: A pity that Solkzagyl found it necessary to subject you and Constaint to such trials. Not that I can question the results, I suppose, but I cannot help but wonder if there was a far simpler way...

24.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_061
24.description: And so Ishgard rejoins the Eorzean Alliance...

25.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_062
25.description: Her Grace will be very busy in the days ahead─as will we, I expect. Have no doubt that the Sultansworn stand ready to serve as her sword and shield.

26.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_071
26.description: To think that a humble free paladin can change the world so. Truly, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, you are something else.

27.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_072
27.description: Aye, I needn't be told of your part in returning Ishgard to the Alliance. Frankly, it would have been more surprising if you <hex:021A020203>hadn't<hex:021A020103> been involved!

28.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_073
28.description: Small wonder Oathkeeper shined so brightly for you...

29.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_000
29.description: So you have registered your participation in the tournament? That is well.

30.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_001
30.description: I shall do my utmost to triumph in my matches, that I might have the opportunity to cross swords with you.

31.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_010
31.description: Though I am wholly unsurprised, full glad am I to see you win through to the final.

32.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_011
32.description: I have every intent of meeting you there, and your rousing display against the realm's finest shall serve to inspire mine own campaign.

33.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_020
33.description: Forgive me, my friend. For all my talk of meeting you in the final, it shames me to say I was bested by Black Lotus.

34.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_021
34.description: Nonetheless, I look forward to seeing you take to the arena against him, myself and all the Sultansworn.

35.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_030
35.description: The news of Black Lotus's withdrawal came as a shock, but if the whispers are true, Guildmaster Mylla is working to see that the final is held.

36.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_031
36.description: I should very much like to see it take place, and I am far from alone in this sentiment.

37.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_040
37.description: My joyous congratulations for your Ul Cup triumph, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Truly, your match against Aldis was one for the songs.

38.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_041
38.description: As was the hidden intent behind the tournament, let us together strive to raise our art to newfound heights. And perhaps one day, Oathkeeper will shine for me as it did for you.

39.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_500_000
39.description: Ah, how fare you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Still honing your sword arm, I trust?

40.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_500_001
40.description: As before, our order works closely with the Gladiators' Guild. In this way do we continue to raise our art to newfound heights, as Her Grace desires.

48.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_100
48.description: Better, it pleases me to say. Our ranks have grown since last we spoke, and the quality of our recruits is much improved.

49.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_101
49.description: I think it safe to say that you bear some responsibility for that. Tales of your deeds have doubtless served as inspiration to many─and I pray they will continue to do so.

50.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_102
50.description: Our ranks have grown since last we spoke, and the quality of our recruits is much improved.

51.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_103
51.description: I think it safe to say that you bear some responsibility for that. Tales of your deeds have doubtless served as inspiration to many.

52.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_104
52.description: There have been <hex:021A020203>other<hex:021A020103> tales told in recent days, of course, but no one with an onze of common sense pays them any heed.

53.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_105
53.description: If Her Grace were not convalescing from illness, she would surely put an end to this madness. Alas, in her absence, the Monetarists are firmly in control...

54.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_101
54.description: Doubtless you saw for yourself the quality of the new recruits. They are raw, I will allow, but you would agree that they have potential.

55.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_102
55.description: ...They are, perhaps, the only cause for celebration of late. <sigh> I understand that Her Grace's condition has yet to improve, but the manner in which she is being sequestered is passing strange.

56.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_111
56.description: Doubtless you saw for yourself the quality of the new recruits. They are raw, I will allow, but you would agree that they have potential.

57.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_112
57.description: ...They are, perhaps, the only cause for celebration of late. <sigh> I understand that Her Grace's condition has yet to improve, but the manner in which she is being sequestered is passing strange.

58.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_113
58.description: That being said, I can at least imagine several possible reasons for that. The way in which your soul crystal reacted to mine, on the other hand─now <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> is something which continues to defy all logical explanation.

59.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_121
59.description: Much, much better, now that Her Grace has regained strength enough to leave her bedchamber.

60.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_122
60.description: You should have seen the faces of the new recruits when she came to greet them in person. It was quite the boost to their morale─and to mine, I must confess.

61.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_131
61.description: Much, much better, now that Her Grace has regained strength enough to leave her bedchamber.

62.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_132
62.description: You should have seen the faces of the new recruits when she came to greet them in person. It was quite the boost to their morale─and to mine, I must confess.

63.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_133
63.description: It has motivated me to delve into our records with a renewed fervor. I know not if they hold the answers we seek, but I can think of nowhere else to look.

64.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_141
64.description: I hardly need explain how the return of Oathkeeper has lifted everyone's spirits.

65.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_142
65.description: Though it has yet to shine for me as it did for you, it still serves as a potent symbol of our values and beliefs.

66.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_143
66.description: ...Had Solkzagyl simply delivered it to us, it would have been much the same, I expect. Yet after going through such efforts to reclaim it, I suppose it is somewhat understandable that he would want to bask in its legendary radiance, if only for a fleeting moment.

67.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_151
67.description: Escorting Her Grace to the Holy See was an unexpected challenge, though we were glad of it.

68.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_152
68.description: I should think that there will be other political visits to be made in future, if recent events are any indication...

69.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_161
69.description: Quite well, though we are rather busy of late.

70.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_162
70.description: Doubtless you are aware that Her Grace attended the ceremony in Ishgard. A necessary─if unexpected─visit, to say the least. The Sultansworn were glad to rise to the challenge, of course.

71.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_163
71.description: In fact, it would seem that every sworn brother and sister has been attending to their duties with a renewed pride ever since Oathkeeper was returned to us.

72.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_164
72.description: ...Had Solkzagyl simply delivered it to us, it would have been much the same, I expect. Yet after going through such efforts to reclaim it, I suppose it is somewhat understandable that he would want to bask in its legendary radiance, if only for a fleeting moment.

73.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_100
73.description: I am pleased to say that our ranks have grown since the Ul Cup. The fruit of our participation in the tournament, 'twould seem.

74.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_101
74.description: Though none of ours made it to the latter stages, neither did we shame ourselves. And I need hardly mention your influence.

75.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_102
75.description: Between protecting the sultana and training our new recruits, I find myself spread thin, but you'll not find me giving any less than my all.

76.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_110
76.description: 'Twas with great joy that we received the tidings of Ala Mhigo's liberation.

77.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_111
77.description: With Ul'dah presently hosting countless refugees, the coming days promise to be hectic for Her Grace, and the same is true for the Sultansworn. But whatever may be required of us, we stand ready to rise to the challenge.

78.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_120
78.description: 'Twas with great joy that we received the tidings of Ala Mhigo's liberation.

79.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_121
79.description: With Ul'dah presently hosting countless refugees, the coming days promise to be hectic for Her Grace, and the same is true for the Sultansworn. But whatever may be required of us, we stand ready to rise to the challenge.

80.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_122
80.description: Our cause has only been bolstered by those who came to join our ranks following the Ul Cup. The fruit of our participation in the tournament, 'twould seem.

81.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_123
81.description: Though none of ours made it to the latter stages, neither did we shame ourselves. And I need hardly mention your influence.

82.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_124
82.description: Between protecting the sultana and training our new recruits, I find myself spread thin, but you'll not find me giving any less than my all.

83.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_600_120
83.description: The sultana was until recently at the very forefront of our efforts to forestall the catastrophes threatening this star. In my capacity as captain of the Sultansworn, it was my duty to accompany Her Grace both here in Ul'dah and abroad on official business.

84.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_600_121
84.description: As you may be aware, she is ever mindful of the hardships faced by the commonfolk, and is wont to embark on jaunts about the city, often in disguise and without prior notice.

85.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_600_122
85.description: Though I and my comrades recognize the value in witnessing the struggles of her subjects, this does put us─her sworn protectors─in a rather difficult position...

86.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_600_123
86.description: Between protecting the sultana and training our new recruits, I find myself spread thin, but you'll not find me giving any less than my all.

92.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_110
92.description: An odd question to come from one so accomplished! But if you wish to hear my words once more, I will oblige.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:02100103>A true paladin is one who bends his knee to a higher cause, and offers his sword and shield without promise of reward.

93.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_111
93.description: The battle arts that the paladin learns have been held secret, nurtured, and perfected within the ranks of the Sultansworn elite for nigh on these six hundred years.

94.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_112
94.description: But remember that fancy swordplay and well-polished armor do not make you a paladin. You must be just in your heart and strive always to be an exemplar of true virtue.

95.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_201
95.description: An odd question to come from one so accomplished! But if you wish to hear my words once more, I will oblige.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:02100103>A true paladin is one who bends his knee to a higher cause, and offers his sword and shield without promise of reward.

96.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_202
96.description: The battle arts that the paladin learns have been held secret, nurtured, and perfected within the ranks of the Sultansworn elite for nigh on these six hundred years.

97.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_203
97.description: But remember that fancy swordplay and well-polished armor do not make you a paladin. You must be just in your heart and strive always to be an exemplar of true virtue.

98.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_204
98.description: Really, though, I cannot imagine why you would feel the need to ask me that. Unless this is some sort of test? If so, I say, you are spending entirely too much time with Solkzagyl...

99.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_120
99.description: Everyone knows that Ul'dah is ruled by the sultana─but everyone also knows that true power lies with the Syndicate. And at the core of the group is a faction that calls itself the Monetarists.

100.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_121
100.description: Of the six who hold seats on the Syndicate, only General Raubahn is faithful to the sultana. Most of the others refuse to accord her due rights, and work to establish “self-governance” for themselves and their wealthy cohorts. It is they who are the Monetarists. It is they who run the Ul'dahn economy.

101.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_122
101.description: “Self-governance” may sound a noble endeavor, but on their lips the words ring hollow. The faction seeks power, and that is why they plot against the Sultansworn, the sultana's last line of protection. They sowed the seeds of our ruin, and nurture them still. The disgrace of our former captain was their doing, of that I have little doubt.

102.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_130
102.description: After everything that has happened, you ask me this? You should know full well that the Monetarists are a faction within the Syndicate─the organization which wields greater influence than the sultana herself.

103.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_131
103.description: Their grip on power has never been stronger, now that General Raubahn has been confined to the Marasaja Pit for his crimes at the royal banquet.

104.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_000_132
104.description: I fear that until the sultana recovers from her illness, Lord Lolorito and his minions will face little opposition. Yet it may be some time before that comes to pass. Her condition is so serious that even I have been denied an audience...

105.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_301
105.description: After everything that has happened, you ask me this? You should know full well that the Monetarists are a faction within the Syndicate─the organization which wields greater influence than the sultana herself.

106.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_302
106.description: I knew they were relentless in their pursuit of power, but I had no idea of the lengths to which they would go...

107.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_303
107.description: Would that Her Grace were not still bedridden! She would have never allowed the Crystal Braves to detain General Raubahn. Thank the gods you dealt with that dishonorable lot.

108.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_311
108.description: Sometimes I wonder if you remember anything at all... <sigh> You should know full well that the Monetarists are a faction within the Syndicate─the organization which wields greater influence than the sultana herself.

109.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_312
109.description: Under most circumstances, they would move in opposition to Her Grace and General Raubahn. These whispers of an agreement between the General and Lord Lolorito would seem to contradict that, though.

110.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_321
110.description: ...As you doubtless are already aware, the Monetarists are a faction within the Syndicate─the organization which wields greater influence than the sultana herself.

111.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_322
111.description: Under most circumstances, they would move in opposition to Her Grace and General Raubahn. These whispers of an agreement between the General and Lord Lolorito would seem to contradict that, though.

112.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_300_323
112.description: ...I suppose it bears repeating that the Monetarists were also the ones who once employed Death's Embrace, the assassins who stole Oathkeeper years ago, which Solkzagyl later recovered. You ought to know this, seeing as you were there when he returned it to us.<hex:02100103>Then again, there was rather a lot going on at the time, so I shouldn't wonder if you were confused. I know I was.

113.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_400
113.description: ...As you doubtless are already aware, the Monetarists are a faction within the Syndicate─the organization which wields greater influence than the sultana herself.

114.name: TEXT_JOBDEFPLD_00091_JENLYNS_400_401
114.description: Under most circumstances, they would move in opposition to Her Grace and Marshal Tarupin. These whispers of an agreement between them and Lord Lolorito would seem to contradict that, though.
